name: Morino Kumi
source:
"It's kind of fateful. I'm thrilled."

She is an energetic member who moved to Tokyo from Kanazawa.
While working as an idol, she is also attending a culinary school.

She also works part-time at a restaurant in a famous hotel in Tokyo.
She is a hard worker and spreads energy to everyone.

However, she is overworked and has a hard time getting out of bed on her days off.
Rumor has it that her reluctance to say "no (ノー)" clearly is the reason for this situation.

She often recharges her energy by fluffing up her companion, Guri, a magical creature.

Her specialty is cooking.

Accompanying magical creature: Guri (bear)

[Based on the [url=https://whirlpool.co.jp/kemonomichi-gs/character/chara04.php]official website[/url]]
